$comment: Contract for workspace/reports/harness_reach_dynamic.json, written by scripts/harness_reach.py dynamic (record_dynamic): per harness module, the gate's entry points the fuzz corpus executed (from the coverage report) and those it never did (`gaps`), with the digest of the harness measured. Rows merge across runs; a module whose coverage was missing or unusable, or left inputs unreplayed (`inputs.not_replayed` > 0), gets no row (an earlier row is dropped), only its reason under `unmeasured` (dropped once it is measured). harness_reach.py check (apply_dynamic) keeps a gap failing while the harness digest is unchanged.

unmeasured.$comment: module -> why its coverage could not be measured (run_dynamic's error)

warnings.$comment: schema problems the producer recorded (validate_artifacts.schema_warning); run-dir fails on them

failed_inputs.$comment: inputs that crashed the coverage replay when every input was replayed (inputs.failed); the reach stands
